rule.metric: Pipeline credit = 0.25 discover + 0.50 starts/use + 0.25 tenure − short flips − bench stash.
rule.discover: First draft/waiver/FA = 1.0; first via trade = 0.35; else 0.05.
rule.use: Belief: 0.75 × (your starts / most starts on this player) + 0.25 if you started them first.
rule.tenure: Seat days / longest seat days on that player.
rule.flip: Penalty 1/(1+short stints); short = under 21 days. Pure short-only seats with no starts score 0 unless first owner.
rule.bench: Held 21d+ with 0 starts while someone else started them → ×0.35 (or ×0.55 if <3 starts exist).
rule.paid: Highest acquire flatten on/before stint start — fact only, does not crown Pipeline.
rule.pos_rank: Within-position rank by current-season Sleeper PPR points (QB/RB/WR/TE).
rule.owner_status: Pipeline winner still owns (held), traded away (trade), or dropped (drop).
